description: One street address in Charleston County: FEMA's flood zone and base flood elevation at the point the Census geocoder places it, the map panel and its date, whether it is inside a town or the City of Charleston, the county tax district, and the ground's height from USGS lidar. Live calls to the government services named in sources. A geocoded point, not a survey — the person confirms on the parcel's elevation certificate.

address.description: Street address with city and ZIP, e.g. "1518 Main Rd, Johns Island, SC 29455"

name: flood_zone

map_panel.description: FEMA panel id and effective date

title: Flood zone for an address
